_doc: OPS profile for the GLOBAL motus-ops-sweep engine — gates the machine that runs the machines on THIS machine: the brain-host orchestrator's schedules, the dream-cycle's step log, Crystal Core's nightly, and the transcript/artifact sources every digest and dashboard count depends on. Personal-machine ops config (paths are ~-absolute, like fleet.json); the engine is dimension-registered in motus-sweep/dimensions.json.

opsRules._why: The failure streak is counted from surviving goals, and brain-host deletes terminal cron goals after 7 days (CRON_GOAL_RETENTION_MS), so a daily schedule's streak tops out at about 7. The engine default of 10 could never fire for a daily schedule; 5 can, with room for retention timing.

stepLogs._why: The logs dir mixes families (lint-/consolidate-/drift- prefixed reports); only the main <date>.md is the step log.

Crystal Core's nightly (LaunchAgent com.jingshi.crystal-nightly, 04:15) logs to ~/Library/Logs/crystal/nightly.log, which has no ## sections and quotes Jing's words. captureCmd's first command, bin/crystal-nightly-status.py, reads that log, launchd and the file names in ~/crystal/backups (read-only) and writes this derived step log, one section per check. This reader takes its `- error:` lines, each an O2 block (override as crystal-nightly#<check>): fresh-run (a run started in the last 30h, done exit 0/0, chain ok, refold identical), launchd (last exit code 0), backup (log-<today|yesterday>.db). 30h, not 24h: the sweep (03:30) runs before the nightly (04:15), so it reads yesterday's run at ~23h, and at more when the Mac slept through both and they fire together on wake. Times, exit codes and counts only.

The same derived log's `- warn:` lines, as O2 advisory: the nightly still exits 0 when its judge can't answer, so these don't block. judge (a `judge: answered N, failed M` line with M > 0 in the latest run), waiting (`judgments waiting for an answer: N` above 0 at the end of each of the last 3 nights). Override as crystal-nightly-warn#<check>.

sources._why: Codex moved to ChatGPT-app cloud threads 2026-07-04 — no local artifacts. Advisory keeps the gap visible until the local surface returns or a cloud poller lands (wiki: codex/codex-session-store-migration-breaks-jsonl-readers).

The engine reads a step-log dir with no matching file as clean, so without this a capture that skipped bin/crystal-nightly-status.py would pass the crystal-nightly and crystal-nightly-warn checks on a missing or old file. Each captureCmd rewrites it seconds before the ops capture.
